commitResults.messageTitle: Set up LittleDaisy with a greeting and a farewell
commitResults.messageBody: Rename Duke.java to LittleDaisy.java so the bot has its own identity, and print a figlet banner, a welcome line and a sign-off. say() takes varargs so replies of any length share the same divider styling.

Add a chat() loop between the greeting and the sign-off: read one trimmed line at a time and repeat it back, stopping on 'bye'. Guard the loop with hasNextLine() so input that ends without 'bye' exits cleanly instead of throwing.
